text:
Owen: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: Elena said our moat is "serving" rather than model ownership. For GTM, what single claim should sales use that isn't just marketing fluff?

Elena (CEO): Use: "Redwood turns model capability into predictable product outcomes: stable latency, transparent unit economics, and enterprise-grade controls across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." One line, outcome-first.

Rhea (Sales): Customers often ask "why not the big cloud providers?" What's a crisp objection rebuttal we can use on calls?

Maya (VP Product): Short: cloud vendors give scale and catalogs; we give a runtime and controls that make models usable in production with measurable cost and latency. Follow with a concrete metric if you have one (e.g., p99 under X ms for short-chat).

Ravi (CTO): Tech add: emphasize our levers — dynamic batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization profiles, and smart routing — and that these compound across requests to reduce effective token cost. Self-hosters miss many of those at scale without steady SRE investment.

Owen: For positioning vs self-hosting, what's the best single-sentence rebuttal for execs?

Elena (CEO): "Self-hosting hides an ops tax and quality-tuning burden; we deliver predictable unit economics and fallbacks so features ship and stay healthy." Keep it short, factual.

Rhea (Sales): Can Product give us a one-pager and two quick rebuttal bullets for SDRs by Friday?

Maya (VP Product): Yes. We'll produce: 1) a one-pager with three competitor archetypes and our counterpoints, 2) two SDR rebuttals (self-host and cloud vendor), and 3) a 30s opener. Delivery EOD Friday.

Elena (CEO): Ops note: Marketing should avoid vague "best models" language. Use measurable outcomes. Internally, standardize p50/p95/p99 by workload shape. Externally, use conservative public numbers with workload context.

Ravi (CTO): Engineering will supply a short tech appendix with scenario->recommended config (short-chat vs long-context) and conservative savings ranges. I'll post by Wed.

Owen: Action items recap?

Elena (CEO): 1) @Maya one-pager + SDR bullets by Fri. 2) @Ravi tech appendix by Wed. 3) @Rhea to pilot SDR script with two AEs this week and report back. I'll review docs before they go external. :thumbsup:

all-hands-bot: Thread archived. Recording and assets will be posted to #all-hands-resources.
